```{r, fig.align='center',fig.height=8, fig.width=12, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)


rm(list=ls())

setwd("E:/Saline-alkali soil/Saline-alkali/amplicon/result-U/Fungi/otu/guild/")

otu_all <- read.csv('../otu_fungiFlattening.csv', check.names = F, header = T)
names(otu_all)[1] <- "OTU.ID"


otu_all <- separate(otu_all, OTU.ID, into = c("phylum","genus"), sep = "g__")

fungal_traits <- read.csv("FungalTraits 1.2_ver_16Dec_2020 - V.1.2.csv")

otu_all1 <- left_join(otu_all,fungal_traits[,c("GENUS", "primary_lifestyle")], by=c("genus"="GENUS"))
otu_all1[is.na(otu_all1$primary_lifestyle),]$primary_lifestyle <- "Unannotated"

otu_all1[otu_all1$primary_lifestyle == "",]$primary_lifestyle <- "Unannotated"
unique(otu_all1$primary_lifestyle)



fungal_traits1 <- aggregate(.~primary_lifestyle, otu_all1[,c(3:28)], FUN = "sum")
unique(fungal_traits1$primary_lifestyle)


# c("Algal Parasite", 
#   "Animal Parasite", 
#   "Animal Pathogen", 
#   "Arbuscular Mycorrhizal", 
#   "Dung Saprotroph", 
#   "Ectomycorrhizal",  
#   "Endophyte", 
#   "Fungal Parasite",
#   "Insect Pathogen", 
#   "Lichen Parasite", 
#   "Lichenized", 
#   "Litter Saprotroph", 
#   "Plant Pathogen", 
#   "Plant Saprotroph", 
#   "Pollen Saprotroph", 
#   "Undefined Saprotroph", 
#   "Wood Saprotroph"
#   )

fungal_traits1$sum <- rowSums(fungal_traits1[2:26])

# calculate relative abundance
my_function <- function(x)x / sum(x)

fungal_traits1[, 2:26] <- apply(fungal_traits1[, 2:26], 2, my_function)


fungal_traits1 <- fungal_traits1[order(fungal_traits1$sum, decreasing = TRUE), ]



 fungal_traits1_tp10 <- fungal_traits1[c(1:22), -ncol(fungal_traits1)]
# ##################################################################################
# # remaining taxon be classfied as Others 
# fungal_traits1_tp10['Others', ][, 2:26] <-1 - colSums(fungal_traits1_tp10[, 2:26])
# fungal_traits1_tp10['Others', ]$guild <- "Others"
# 
# 
# 
# if (length(fungal_traits1_tp10[, 1]) <= 10) {
#   genus_top10 <- na.omit(fungal_traits1_tp10)
# }  # if less than ten, remove NA

 
 
 m1 = brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
 m2 = brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
 
 Palette1 <-
   c("#B2182B","#E69F00","#56B4E9","#009E73","#F0E442","#0072B2","#D55E00",
     "#CC79A7","#CC6666","#9999CC","#66CC99","#ADD1E5")
 Palette2 <-
   c('blue','orange','green','yellow','red','hotpink','cyan','purple',
     'burlywood1','skyblue','#8b2578','#458b74','#f0ffff','#eeb422',
     '#ee6aa7','#8b3a62','#cd5c5c','#ee6363','#f0e68c','#e6e6fa','#add8e6',
     '#bfefff','#f08080','#d1eeee','#8b814c','#8b5f65')
 mix <- c(m1, Palette2, Palette1, m2)
 
 
 
 
#set color
# set last one as grey(others is grey)
colour <- mix[1:nrow(fungal_traits1_tp10)]
 if (nrow(fungal_traits1_tp10) > 10) {
  colour[length(colour)] <- 'gray'
  }

fungal_traits1_tp10_1 <- melt(fungal_traits1_tp10, id = 'primary_lifestyle')

fungal_traits1_tp10_1$variable <- substr(fungal_traits1_tp10_1$variable,1,3)
fungal_traits1_tp10_2 <- aggregate(.~variable+primary_lifestyle, fungal_traits1_tp10_1, FUN = "mean")




trait_order <- rev(c(fungal_traits1_tp10$primary_lifestyle[2:22],fungal_traits1_tp10$primary_lifestyle[1]))

p1 <<-
  ggplot(fungal_traits1_tp10_2, aes(factor(variable, levels = c("CKU","JPU","CLU","MHU","YMU")), 100 * value, 
                                    fill = factor(primary_lifestyle, levels = trait_order))) +
  geom_col(position = 'stack', width = 0.5)  +
  geom_text(data=fungal_traits1_tp10_2,aes(label=ifelse(value > 0.05, paste0(round(value * 100), "%"), ""), 
            color=factor(variable)),
            position = position_stack(vjust =0.5),size=4,fontface="bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  rev(colour)) +
  #  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 6, 1),expand = c(0.03, 0.03)) +  # The distance between the left and right columns and the axis
  labs(fill = "Primary lifestyle") +
  ggtitle("FungalTraits") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    'CKU' = "Bareland", 
    'MHU' = "Cotton", 
    'YMU' = "Maize", 
    'JPU' = "Suaeda",
    'CLU' = "Tamarix")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("white","white","white","white","white","white","white","white")) +
  labs(x = 'Plant', y = 'Relative Abundance(%)') +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1),
         color="none") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme( 
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(color = 'black', fill = 'transparent'),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 25, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15, color= "black", face= "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face= "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "inches"), 
    legend.background = element_blank())

p1
```
